correctness.rationale: Trace cyclicity and equal negative determinant of the two annual matrices, the exact commutator determinant, and the Perron quadratic prove the entire parameter-wise trichotomy. Independence gives the mean-vector recurrence. The exact rational example has determinants and discriminants verified by independent Fraction arithmetic, yielding a precise open probability interval. The 16,128 finite checks corroborate, not replace, the universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural phase-randomization problem with exactly the same environmental inventory and identical deterministic long-run growth has a sharp benefit/harm/no-effect criterion. A biologically admissible rational example has two subcritical deterministic annual policies but an explicit interval of supercritical expected-population growth. This cleanly distinguishes deterministic Floquet equivalence from annealed growth; no real-world persistence is inferred.
